Dr. Jain is a senior specialist at Thera Care with 19 years of experience in the Chiropractic, Sports Injury fields. He completed a master's in chiropractic diploma from Sweden He has cured thousands of patients with his in-depth knowledge and understanding of human body anatomy, Biomechanics, & Physiology.
Dr. Anoop Jain practices Chiropractic, Osteopathy, Dry needling, Physical Therapy, Cupping, Sports Taping, Needling Garston Technique, Tapping. 
He has equipped with extensive clinical experience;  Chiropractor treatment, Musculoskeletal Conditions & Sports injury conditions.
